runtime.auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable; never written to a record or log

model.note: Version string is the pinned identity for behavioral validation. Anthropic's claude-opus-5 model ID does not include date suffix. Any change requires re-validation on held-out fixtures per contract change_rule.

sampling.rationale: Lowest-variance sampling for repeatable structure. Reproducibility is behavioral, not bitwise: the same brief and model version satisfy the same declared properties, but token sequences may differ.

prompt_template.note: Template hash is still required before invocation under contract 1.1.0.

declared_properties: schema conformance against PLAN_SCHEMA, DRAFT_SCHEMA, REPAIR_SCHEMA
abstention when evidence is missing or contradictory
structural bounds: word budgets and the three-cycle repair cap
mutation response: graceful abstention or downstream-detectable failure on corrupted input
reproducibility.limitation_disclosure: An auditor can re-run the property suite against the declared model version. An auditor cannot cryptographically verify the token sequence of a historical run.

isolation.model_output_handling: delimited JSON validated against the target schema before use; validation failure produces abstention, never execution
isolation.network: API egress to the declared endpoint only; parser and compiler remain network-denied
isolation.secrets: API key read from the environment; excluded from run manifests, findings, and CLI stdout
isolation.rationale: T4 authority boundary is unchanged. T3 now permits logged API egress for prose generation while keeping untrusted-code execution paths isolated.

budget.on_exceeded: fail explicitly with exit code 2 and record the limit; never continue unbounded

local_fallback.status: available but not the main path
local_fallback.note: Retained for offline work. Prose quality at 3B is not publishable and no release claim may rest on it.

verification.result: profile recorded; live property validation pending
verification.observation: Contract 1.1.0 prerequisites recorded: model version string pinned, prompt template hashed, budget caps declared, secret handling declared. No API invocation has been validated against the property suite yet.
verification.next_action: Implement the API adapter and the property suite, then record the first validation run.
